packageRules.description: Every update is build(deps); config:recommended would make runtime ones fix(deps).
The shared workflows are called by an immutable tag that moves by hand, in step with a release of this repository.
kube pins the k8s-openapi minor it builds against, and two k8s-openapi versions in one build fail its build script.
Renovate takes only the newest version of each bucket, and minor and patch share one by default: a newer minor would take the patch's place and then be disabled below, leaving no update at all.
A release branch takes fixes only. A major or minor update there would be a feature, and for a dependency tagged by Talos line, another line.
